name: REEVES
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A Rev2-style bi-timbral poly, 8 or 16 voices: two shape-modulated oscillators, sub, noise, sync, a 4-pole/2-pole low-pass, three envelopes, four LFOs, eight mod slots, an effect per layer, arp, poly and gated sequencers, unison, stack and split. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages per layer.
